name: Kohaku
source:
Hobbies: Thinking (?)
Likes: Quiet places
Dream: Reconstructing the village

Born on the continent of Pangea. Kohaku became a traveler after her home village was destroyed by an army. She happens to meet Einlark and Will on her journey and joins their unit. Kohaku is the last master of the ancient Pangea Jiu-Jitsu (a type of ninjutsu).

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20010123100400/http://www.web-giga.com/seihin/win_pure/p_kohaku.htm]official website[/url].]
